patthana23.48:1.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na ācayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.48:2.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na apacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho apacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.48:3.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekavīsa. nasanidassanattika nasekkhattike sanidassanattika sekkhattikaṃ
